picks.excerpt: Researchers used automated robotics plus chemical AI to sweep 960 reaction conditions of the 135-year-old Biginelli reaction, uncovering a previously unknown branch that yields complex bicyclic molecules with metal-responsive assembly and programmable chiral sorting.
picks.rationale: Closed-loop robot lab + chemical AI finds a new branch in a 135-year-old named reaction — the clearest concrete case this week of research automation producing genuinely new chemistry.

picks.excerpt: UCL scientists reconstructed 10-second videos from the brain activity of mice using only signals from neurons in the visual cortex, a decoding advance that could reveal how the brain reshapes what we see before it becomes perception.
picks.rationale: Ten-second video reconstructed from visual-cortex spikes alone — a measurable jump in neural decoding, and a new instrument for separating sensation from perception.

picks.excerpt: A search for the most complex elliptic curves had taken mathematicians years. Claude beat the record in days, raising questions about how much of mathematical search work AI can now absorb.
picks.rationale: A record that stood on years of human search fell in days — a concrete, checkable result that marks where AI now eats the search half of mathematics.

picks.excerpt: IonQ, Oak Ridge National Laboratory and research partners demonstrated a generative AI method that sharply reduces parameter-tuning time for quantum optimization circuits.
picks.rationale: Parameter tuning is the practical bottleneck in variational quantum optimization; a generative model that collapses it changes what a lab can actually run this year.

picks.excerpt: University of Edinburgh researchers built room-temperature skyrmion-based artificial synapses that exploit collective magnetic transformations rather than individual skyrmion manipulation, pointing to far lower energy consumption for AI hardware at high computational accuracy.
picks.rationale: Room-temperature operation and collective — not single-skyrmion — control is the step that moves spintronic synapses from cryostat demo toward usable low-energy AI hardware.
